ops.text: Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience, in whole or in part, upon thirty days' prior written notice to Vendor, without penalty or early-termination charge, in which case Vendor shall refund any prepaid Fees for the period after the effective date of termination. Vendor has no right to terminate this Agreement or an Order Form for convenience during a committed term.

input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has a three-year term with no Customer right to exit without cause, so we have added a 30 days' notice convenience right with a pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees. If needed we can move to 60 days' notice, but we cannot commit for three years with no exit.
input.summary: Insert Customer termination for convenience on 30 days' notice with prepaid-fee refund.

ops.oldText: governed exclusively by Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction
ops.newText: governed exclusively by the laws of the State of New York, and the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York have exclusive jurisdiction

input.comment: [Playbook] Our position is New York law and New York County courts; Singapore is outside our accepted list and also contradicts the New York venue already agreed in Section 28.2. Delaware, California or England and Wales would be acceptable alternatives.
input.summary: Replace Singapore law/courts with New York law and New York County courts.

ops.oldText: Vendor exclusively owns every Deliverable created for Customer. Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
ops.newText: Customer exclusively owns every Deliverable created for Customer, and Vendor assigns to Customer all right, title and interest in each Deliverable upon creation. To the extent any Deliverable is found not to be owned by Customer, Vendor grants Customer and its Affiliates a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, modify, create derivative works from, and sublicense that Deliverable for Customer's business.

input.comment: [Playbook] We own the work product we pay for, so we have reversed the ownership of Deliverables and added a perpetual, irrevocable licence back-stop; a revocable, term-limited licence to Deliverables is not acceptable. Vendor's ownership of Vendor Technology under Sections 14.3 and 1.8 is unchanged.
input.summary: Give Customer ownership of Deliverables with a perpetual licence fallback.

ops.oldText: Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: Any minimum purchase commitment applies only to the current twelve-month term, is stated in an Order Form, and may be reduced by Customer on thirty days' written notice. Any shortfall is settled as a true-up of Fees for Services actually ordered and not as a penalty or take-or-pay charge.

input.comment: [Playbook] We do not accept multi-year take-or-pay with no reduction or exit, so we have limited any commitment to the current 12-month term, made it reducible on 30 days' notice, and replaced the shortfall charge with a true-up.
input.summary: Limit the minimum commitment to 12 months, reducible, with a true-up instead of take-or-pay.

ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or an Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty days of request, return all Customer Data in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems and certify that deletion in writing, subject to routine backups and legal retention requirements.

input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement refers to a transition period but imposes no exit obligations, so we have added transition assistance of up to six months and return of Customer Data in machine-readable form within 30 days, followed by certified deletion. We can accept 90 days of assistance as a fallback.
input.summary: Insert transition assistance, data return and certified deletion in Section 10.
